notes: Every match/tournament name read in full at all three widths — no truncation hiding a side of a fixture or a Norwegian name (e.g. 'Brighton & Hove Albion – Leeds United', 'Nottingham Forest – Tottenham Hotspur', 'Fredrikstad – Bodø/Glimt', 'Rayo Vallecano – Racing Santander') — no repeat of the historical 'Brazil – Nor…' truncation bug.
Every agenda row and every 'DIREKTE NÅ' live item shows a channel, and every one seen is Norwegian/Scandinavian: TV 2, TV 2 Play, Viaplay, HBO Max (Sport), Discovery+, VG+ Sport — no FOX/ESPN/Sky.

No horizontal scroll or overflow at any width; nothing clipped at the screen edge; chevrons and (i) info icons stay fully visible on every inspected row, including at 375px, verified by scrolling through the full page in viewport-sized captures (not just the squashed full-page shot).

Club crests and national flags render as real images (no broken-image icons or empty boxes) at every width, including small tournament flags (F1, DP World Tour) and a plain calendar icon for entries without a crest (e.g. Kolstad – Runar).

Must-see accent dots appear sparingly (a handful per day: US Open, Fredrikstad–Bodø/Glimt, Ipswich Town–Liverpool, Real Betis–Real Madrid, Rosenborg–HamKam, Manchester City–Coventry City, Brann–Lillestrøm, Valencia–Barcelona, Molde–KFUM Oslo, Arsenal–Chelsea), not on every row.

Header (wordmark, date, theme toggle), day-group headings ('I DAG', 'I MORGEN', weekday headers), and footer (calendar-subscribe line, AI-budsjett line, esports 'NESTE OPP' block, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures) all intact and aligned at all three widths.
Single quiet column, generous spacing, scannable — not a cluttered grid — at all three widths; at 900px the column sits centered with balanced empty margins on both sides.

The floating 'Assistent' button never covers the last agenda row or the footer at any width — confirmed by scrolling to the true bottom of the page at 375/393/900px; at 900px it rests entirely in the empty right margin beside the 640px column, per the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom.
